title: Locksmith Equipment Inspection Report Form
subtitle: Control authority verification, access service, key control, testing, and secure release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete locksmith service equipment inspection report for openings, locks, keys, credentials, closers, and access devices. It connects verified access authority and approved security scope to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified locksmith must inspect openings, locks, keys, credentials, closers, and access devices against stated criteria and issue a traceable condition, restriction, corrective-action, or release decision.

sections.title: Locksmith inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Do not infer whole-asset or whole-site condition from a limited, inaccessible, or unqualified inspection.

blocks.label: Inspection access and control readiness
items: Minimum necessary identity and access authority verified
Property, vehicle, opening, and approved work scope matched
Reusable secrets, access codes, bitting data, and identity copies excluded from general notes
Fire-rated, egress, shared, master-key, and restricted-keyway conditions identified
Alarm, access-control, building, and affected-user coordination completed
Keys, blanks, cylinders, cores, credentials, and removed hardware controlled
Occupied area, property finishes, privacy, and emergency access protected
Additional openings, keys, credentials, or hierarchy changes require new approval
Door remains securable or an approved interim control is assigned
Functional, latch, lock, closer, credential, and egress tests defined

sections.title: Locksmith measurements, instruments, and evidence package
sections.guidance: Preserve readings and source evidence needed to reproduce the inspection decision.

blocks.label: Measurement, test, and instrument log
blocks.guidance: Applicable concepts include: Door, frame, backset, thickness, or hardware dimension, Latch, strike, clearance, alignment, or closer setting, Key, core, blank, or credential quantity, Voltage or signal at powered access hardware, Lock, latch, closer, credential, and egress test, Response, unlock, relock, or alarm-restoration time.

Issued key or credential count and recipient

sections.guidance: Separate the immediate protection from the corrective action and from the final serviceability decision.

Key, blank, core, credential, code, or removed-hardware custody discrepancy

sections.title: Locksmith equipment inspection report closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This locksmith service equipment inspection report is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when identity, access authority, property scope, key control, alarm integration, fire egress, security function, or credential custody is uncertain. A locksmith, security, or egress supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
